businesses.business: downhole drilling tool rentals and manufacturing

offering_description.value: The company rents downhole drilling tools and sells specialized well construction tools to oil and gas operators, drilling contractors, and oilfield service companies. It designs and manufactures specialty tools and maintains rental fleets at service locations near drilling markets.

primary_products.value: Drill pipe and drill collars; drill string stabilizers and subs; wellbore conditioning tools; casing and completion tools

primary_services.value: Downhole tool rental; tool inspection, repair, and refurbishment; precision machining

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas operators, drilling contractors, directional drilling companies, and other oilfield service firms

end_markets.value: Onshore and offshore oil and gas drilling; well construction and completions

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Use of drill string equipment and specialized downhole tools on well projects; product sales: Specialized wellbore conditioning, casing, and completion tools; service fees: Tool machining, repair, and refurbishment
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Maintains downhole tool fleets and rents equipment to operators, drilling contractors, and oilfield service firms; OEM / manufacturer: Designs and machines specialized downhole tools for operators and oilfield service firms

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and international markets including the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Drill string rentals, wellbore conditioning tools, casing and completion tools, and tool machining and refurbishment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales and rental teams serving operators, contractors, and oilfield service firms; own locations: Rental and service facilities near major drilling regions; partners / resellers: Oilfield service partners that supply specialty tools to drilling customers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Tool machining, handling, and servicing are subject to workplace safety and environmental rules, including OSHA requirements at U.S. facilities.

notes: The current country-by-country footprint and mix of international sales channels are uncertain.
